result.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
result.summary: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Depth Pro 2：用单一可扩展网络统一处理图像与视频，在原生分辨率下输出稠密 metric depth，使深度图同时满足度量准确、边界锐利与跨帧时序一致，并发布一组在精度、锐利度、一致性与运行时间上构成新 Pareto 前沿的模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 原文以单网络联合训练来权衡「跨帧时序一致」与「单帧边界锐利」，可能可供核查 LVR 中复用先前 latent 状态与重新提取视觉证据之间的取舍，以及高分辨率视觉细节在内部状态中的保留程度；但该工作本身属稠密几何预测，非推理研究。
